status: Stopped for computational feasibility; pilot/feasibility data only.
reason: The exhaustive 5-epoch design needs ~130 hours (about 5 days) of continuous laptop CPU time (measured: 126 runs; cost model in the stop record). The PI judged this impractical. Computational-feasibility decision, not result-based.
unrelated_to_outcomes: The stop was decided by the PI from runtime alone. During H2-C only run counts, runtimes and errors were monitored; no recovered-accuracy value of the landscape runs was summarised, inspected or used.
